source: ALMA Partnership et al. (2015), ApJL 808, L3, Figure 2(b), page 6 of arXiv:1503.02649v3. The 256 underlying vector-painted RGB rectangles supply the colors, excluding overlaid tick strokes. Their nine printed flux ticks calibrate a power transfer, fitted on seven ticks and checked on the withheld 0.6 and 3.0 mJy/beam ticks. The recovered bar runs from +0.022 to 5.832 mJy/beam, with display power approximately 0.55. The caption says -2 rms at the low end, but its tick positions reproduce +2 rms to within 0.1 microJy/beam; this table follows the actual calibrated bar. 512 entries sample equal flux intervals. This is a false-color brightness display for millimeter emission, not visible color.
